preconditions.description: The number of wood planks in the fence is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
The height of each plank is between 1 and 109, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each query specifies a valid range of planks within the fence.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == number of distinct matching pieces for the i-th query
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the number of distinct matching pieces of the fence for the given range.
